objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Make the API read a file of your choosing from the server's disk (or run a command on it), and get /ctf/flag.
hints: The home endpoint greets you in a language picked by a query string parameter: where does the greeting text come from?
The parameter is treated as a file name, and the only defence strips one traversal sequence. Is a relative path even needed?

steps.title: Find the input
steps.prompt: Which query string parameter of the root endpoint names the file that is read?

steps.title: Name the flaw
steps.prompt: Which vulnerability class lets a file name escape the folder the developer intended?

steps.title: Another way in
steps.prompt: Which endpoint listed in Swagger hands its input to /bin/sh? (its path)
